KoskNazims.title: Köşk nazımları
KoskNazims.readOnly: The Medaris administration appoints the köşk nazımları; you cannot change this list from here.
KoskNazims.caption: The köşk nazımları of {kosk}
KoskNazims.empty: This köşk has no köşk nazımı.
KoskNazims.abilitiesHeading: A köşk nazımı in this köşk

abilities.1: Changes the köşk's details, visibility and policies; hides the köşk.
abilities.2: Opens courses that are not a medrese's; chooses their müderrisler and imam.
abilities.3: Appoints course nazırs and gives permissions in courses that are not a medrese's.
abilities.4: Sees the content of every course in the köşk (every reading in a course where they are not a müderris is written to the audit log); bars a student from a course or from the köşk, hides a course.
abilities.5: Gives medreses a hosting right in this köşk or takes it back.
abilities.6: Opens köşk decks; receives the müderrisler's suggestions.

KoskNazims.abilitiesNote: A medrese opens its own courses and picks their müderrisler; a köşk nazımı does not change that.
